mapper.select: SELECT cmpy_type_cd, menu_id, menu_nm, url_addr, npag_yn, up_menu_id, sort_sn, scrn_size, menu_use_yn FROM cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_menu WHERE cmpy_type_cd = #{cmpyTypeCd} ORDER BY sort_sn ASC, menu_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_menu ( cmpy_type_cd, menu_id, menu_nm, url_addr, npag_yn, up_menu_id, sort_sn, scrn_size, menu_use_yn, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( #{cmpyTypeCd}, #{menuId}, #{menuNm}, #{urlAddr}, #{npagYn}, #{upMenuId}, #{sortSn}, #{scrnSize}, #{menuUseYn}, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'system', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE cdm_own.cmpt_cmpy_menu SET menu_nm = #{menuNm}, url_addr = #{urlAddr}, npag_yn = #{npagYn}, up_menu_id = #{upMenuId}, sort_sn = #{sortSn}, scrn_size = #{scrnSize}, menu_use_yn = #{menuUseYn}, mdfr_id = 'system', mdfcn_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE cmpy_type_cd = #{cmpyTypeCd} AND menu_id = #{menuId}
